name: Palo Dinner Slow-Braised Veal Osso Buco & Pan-Seared Mediterranean Branzino / Dover Sole
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder & Magic · Palo / Disney Treasure · Palo Steakhouse (Dinner)
whyItWorks: Tableside-filleted Dover Sole / Mediterranean Branzino and slow-braised Veal Osso Buco over saffron risotto are tender, high-protein Italian classics.
prepOrOrderInstructions: On the Veal Osso Buco, ask the kitchen to hold the lemon-peel gremolata garnish; on the Dover Sole or Branzino, request olive oil and caper-free butter with zero lemon juice.
watchOuts: Lemon zest in traditional Osso Buco gremolata (ask to hold)
Lemon juice in tableside fish butter (ask to hold)
